page.layout: One printed page (right side of the opening), blank except for ink marks and manuscript scribbles; no printed text block. Manuscript writing and ink blots on the left margin are handwriting and show-through, not printed text.
page.notes: The page carries only ink blots, pen strokes and a few scribbled marks (a flourished word near the centre and a short signature-like scrawl below it). These are handwriting and stains, not printed text, and are therefore not transcribed. The left edge shows manuscript notes from the facing page, also not transcribed.
